Lightfield is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Lightfield is an AI-native CRM for companies to capture, analyze, and understand everything about their customers. Lightfield employs 48 people (+100.0% YoY, +24 people). Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Canada, and India.

# Lightfield Medical

Lightfield Medical is a Medical Equipment Manufacturing company. Lightfield Medical is a company that provides an autonomous slit-lamp imaging system designed to standardize image quality, simplify clinical workflows, and enable scalable, cloud-connected care across ophthalmology and optometry settings. Lightfield Medical employs 13 people, founded in 2024. Headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States, with presence in Spain. Its workforce is distributed across Spain, Greece, and United States.

## About

Lightfield Medical is pioneering a new era in anterior imaging technology.

Our proprietary platform combines precision optics, intelligent automation, and secure cloud connectivity to enable consistent, high-quality anterior imaging in a connected environment.

For decades, slit-lamp imaging has relied on manual operation and variable results. Lightfield is developing a new approach designed to standardize image capture and simplify the imaging process across diverse settings.

Built with advanced optics and engineered for always in-focus quality, Lightfield’s patented technology supports reliable visualization, secure data handling, and seamless integration into modern workflows.

Our mission is to help shape the future of connected eye care — improving efficiency, accessibility, and image consistency through innovation.

Headquartered in the US, with operations in Spain and Greece, Lightfield unites leading experts in ophthalmology, optics, and medical device design.

properties.name: Lightfield Medical
properties.description:
Lightfield Medical is pioneering a new era in anterior imaging technology.

Our proprietary platform combines precision optics, intelligent automation, and secure cloud connectivity to enable consistent, high-quality anterior imaging in a connected environment.

For decades, slit-lamp imaging has relied on manual operation and variable results. Lightfield is developing a new approach designed to standardize image capture and simplify the imaging process across diverse settings.

Built with advanced optics and engineered for always in-focus quality, Lightfield’s patented technology supports reliable visualization, secure data handling, and seamless integration into modern workflows.

Our mission is to help shape the future of connected eye care — improving efficiency, accessibility, and image consistency through innovation.

Headquartered in the US, with operations in Spain and Greece, Lightfield unites leading experts in ophthalmology, optics, and medical device design.
